# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_MEAN_REVERSION_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price deviates significantly from VWAP during flat ribbon (range-bound) conditions with declining volume, a reversion to VWAP offers a short opportunity. This edge exists because in ranging markets, price tends to revert to the mean (VWAP) after extended deviations, especially when volume is drying up, indicating lack of conviction to continue the move.

## Mechanism

**Entry:**  
- Ribbon flat: 8 EMA crosses 21 EMA <2 times in the last 20 bars, and 55 EMA slope near zero (|slope| < 0.001)  
- Price > VWAP + 1.5 × 20-ATR  
- Volume < 80% of 20-period average volume  
- Bearish candle closes below prior bar's midpoint (close < (prior high + prior low)/2)  

**Exit:**  
- Stop: recent swing high (if formed) or 1x ATR above entry, whichever is closer to entry  
- Target: VWAP (mean reversion) or 1R (profit equals risk), whichever occurs first  
- Invalidation: exit if price closes above VWAP (short thesis invalidated)
